tweet.text:
Your AI agent needs access to real systems — not a raw credential dump.

GraphJin is a compiler and runtime for teams connecting AI agents to databases, files, source code, workflows, and metadata.

It helps you give agents a governed way to discover, query, and act across those systems by exposing a shared GraphQL + MCP surface with built-in discovery and validation paths.

Key features:

• GraphQL + MCP interface – query data, files, source code, workflows, and system metadata through one surface
• Discovery before action – catalog search, query help, relationship evidence, and examples guide agents before they run queries
• Guarded access – source-mode access, query allow-lists, read-only boundaries, and policy-aware MCP tools support controlled changes
• Broad source support – works with SQL databases, MongoDB, object stores, local files, and CodeSQL source indexes
• Built-in demo – `graphjin serve --demo` starts a seeded SQLite SaaS demo with saved queries and workflows

It’s open-source (Apache License 2.0).

Link in the reply 👇
